objective: Maximize useful roadmap throughput while preserving correctness, integrity, and WIP=1.
rules: WIP=1 on the main roadmap; Agent 2 remains HOLD.
Front Controller immediately claims the next logical phase; target claim latency <5 minutes.
After terminal EXECUTE, run mechanical completion checks and enter VERIFY immediately; no idle handoff gap.
After VERIFY PASS, checkpoint promotion and route the next smallest gate in the same work cycle.
During stochastic live waits, only do safe non-overlapping offline prep/audit for the same roadmap; never start a second live controller.
Environmental nonappearance is classified, not repeatedly brute-forced. One targeted retry only when policy supports it; repeated nonappearance triggers harness refinement.
No maintenance/backlog work while a core gate is active unless tiny, reversible, and directly reduces measured bottleneck.
Publish only material user updates; suppress routine polling and duplicate status.
Keep exact acceptance-to-acceptance timing refreshed after each milestone.
Never trade save integrity, ownership safety, causal proof, or evidence quality for speed.
today_priority: Finish v0.2.10.17 runtime factual memory-state comparison shadow.
Analyzer VERIFY and promote/reject immediately after terminal evidence.
Pull the next smallest roadmap gate from Analyzer; keep factual state separate from semantics unless prior-art/evidence supports promotion.
Maintain zero avoidable activation/handoff idle while office remains OPEN.

productivity_target.wording: 100% of avoidable working time should be assigned to useful authorized work; stochastic/game wait time is used for safe same-roadmap prep where possible.
productivity_target.note: This is an operating target, not a guarantee that every minute produces an acceptance milestone.
